verdict.rationale: BVNK provides real-time webhooks for account/payment state changes (bvnk-docs-2), including specific events like ledger report readiness (bvnk-docs-32), and offers signed webhook validation via Hawk-based signatures and a dedicated client-side validator tool (bvnk-docs-21, bvnk-docs-30, bvnk-docs-29). This directly covers payment/payout/conversion state notifications without polling. Missing for 10: explicit enumerated list of all event types (payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed) and independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability.
